details:
KEMET ROCKET is an educational game and website that turns teenagers' curiosity about space into real learning through play.

Players design their own rocket, learn about space science, and complete missions in a fun, interactive way. Instead of reading boring lessons, they learn by building, testing, and flying.

Our project helps teenagers understand astronomy, physics, and space exploration in a simple and exciting way. It makes science accessible to everyone, even without expensive tools or special schools.

We developed our project using web technologies, game design tools, and educational content inspired by NASA's open data. Our team focused on making the design colorful, easy to use, and motivating for young learners.

Our project is creative because it combines learning, gaming, and Egyptian identity - KEMET - to inspire a new generation to love science and dream about space.

Our intended impact is to make space education fun, build confidence in young learners, and inspire future scientists, engineers, and astronauts.
